name: Extract audio track from a video
description: Pulls the audio out of any video file into a 44.1 kHz mono WAV — the first step for transcription, subtitles, re-muxing or voice replacement.
notes: Accepts only paths inside the project directory — a form field must not become an arbitrary file read. ffmpeg 9.0.1 from the Hermes tools directory.

parameters.label: Video file (absolute path inside the project)
